# Abel & Cole

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Organic food delivery company based in England. Sells fruit and vegetable boxes, meat and fish, dairy, bakery, pantry items, recipe kits, household products, homeware and pet items. Delivers to areas on a fixed weekly day, checked by postcode.
